title: Python TOFU saturation returns authenticated frame after evicting its new pin
description: During receive, LinkLayer inserts a new peer pin then evicts any unleased entry. If all 64 established pins are generation-leased, the newly inserted unleased sender is selected and removed, yet receive still constructs and returns RxFrame. Node can deliver raw payload from a sender that is no longer pinned/current; a repro returns RxFrame with the new peer absent from pins. Fail admission before returning unless a durable pin/current generation remains, or reject capacity without mutating existing trust. Add all-leased saturation, raw/SCHC/RPL delivery, lease release, and pin/generation consistency tests.
